scripts.text:
[MvP Ladder Warper]
Say... do you want to play the MvP Ladder game?
scripts.translation:
[MVP阶梯传送员]
话说……你想参加MVP阶梯挑战吗？

scripts.text: Yes, let's get it on!
scripts.translation: 是的，开始吧！

scripts.text: Information.
scripts.translation: 资讯。

scripts.text: Show me the best record.
scripts.translation: 显示最佳记录。

scripts.text: No.
scripts.translation: 不。

scripts.text:
[MvP Ladder Warper]
In this game, your party has to kill every single MvP monster in ascending order, from the weakest to strongest.
If your party can finish the MVP ladder game, each member will earn {0}.
But the entrance fee is {1} zeny.
scripts.translation:
[MVP阶梯传送员]
在这个游戏中，你的队伍必须按照从弱到强的顺序，击杀所有的MVP魔物。
如果你的队伍能够完成MVP阶梯挑战，每位成员将获得{0}。
但入场费是{1}泽尼。

scripts.text:
[MvP Ladder Warper]
In this game, your party has to kill every single MvP monster in ascending order, from the weakest to strongest.
But the entrance fee is {0} zeny.
scripts.translation:
[MVP阶梯传送员]
在这个游戏中，你的队伍必须按照从弱到强的顺序，击杀所有的MVP魔物。
但入场费是{0}泽尼。

scripts.text:
[MvP Ladder Warper]
In this game, your party has to kill every single MvP monster in ascending order, from the weakest to strongest.
If your party can finish the MVP ladder game, each member will earn {0}.
scripts.translation:
[MVP阶梯传送员]
在这个游戏中，你的队伍必须按照从弱到强的顺序，击杀所有的MVP魔物。
如果你的队伍能够完成MVP阶梯挑战，每位成员将获得{0}。

scripts.text:
[MvP Ladder Warper]
In this game, your party has to kill every single MvP monster in ascending order, from the weakest to strongest.
scripts.translation:
[MVP阶梯传送员]
在这个游戏中，你的队伍必须按照从弱到强的顺序，击杀所有的MVP魔物。

scripts.text:
[MvP Ladder Warper]
You lose the game if you can't finish in {0} minutes, or if your entire party is killed.
Good luck!
scripts.translation:
[MVP阶梯传送员]
如果你们无法在{0}分钟内完成，或者全队阵亡，则视为挑战失败。
祝你好运！

scripts.text:
[MvP Ladder Warper]
Nobody has finished this game yet.
scripts.translation:
[MVP阶梯传送员]
目前还没有人完成过这个挑战。

scripts.text:
[MvP Ladder Warper]
The best record is
[ {0} min {1} sec ]
By the party ^FF0000{2}^000000.
^000000{3}. ^0000FF{4}

[MvP Ladder Warper]
The best record is
[ {0} min {1} sec ]
By the party ^FF0000{2}^000000.
scripts.translation:
[MVP阶梯传送员]
最佳记录是
[ {0}分 {1}秒 ]
由队伍 ^FF0000{2}^000000 创造。

scripts.text: Close.
scripts.translation: 关闭。

scripts.text: Reset the record.
scripts.translation: 重置记录。

scripts.text: Never mind.
scripts.translation: 算了。

scripts.text: I really want to reset it.
scripts.translation: 我确实想重置它。

scripts.text:
[MvP Ladder Warper]
Record reset successfully.
scripts.translation:
[MVP阶梯传送员]
记录已成功重置。

scripts.text:
[MvP Ladder Warper]
When you are strong enough to complete the game, please come back.
scripts.translation:
[MVP阶梯传送员]
等你足够强大可以完成挑战时，请再来。

scripts.text:
[MvP Ladder Warper]
You have to form a party to play.
scripts.translation:
[MVP阶梯传送员]
你必须组成一个队伍才能参加。

scripts.text:
[MvP Ladder Warper]
Only the party leader can register.
scripts.translation:
[MVP阶梯传送员]
只有队长可以报名。

scripts.text:
[MvP Ladder Warper]
You have to form a party with exactly {0} members to play.
scripts.translation:
[MVP阶梯传送员]
你必须组成一个恰好有{0}名成员的队伍才能参加。

scripts.text:
[MvP Ladder Warper]
Your party must have {0} members online on map '{1}'.
scripts.translation:
[MVP阶梯传送员]
你的队伍必须有{0}名成员在线并位于地图“{1}”上。

scripts.text:
[MvP Ladder Warper]
You don't have enough zeny. Please come back when you do.
scripts.translation:
[MVP阶梯传送员]
你的泽尼不足。请凑够后再来。

scripts.text:
[MvP Ladder Warper]
I'm sorry, but a party is currently playing the game. Please standby until the party is finished.
Thank you.
scripts.translation:
[MVP阶梯传送员]
抱歉，目前已有队伍正在进行挑战。请等待该队伍结束后再来。
谢谢。
